notes: Chunk 121: 25 candidates reviewed from saved text; 4 program-list, 0 single-record, 21 not-a-list. Institutions kept as given by host. Columbia management placement page is the Management Division only (OB/strategy), with 'initial placement' by PhD year 2009-2023 and postdocs marked; it complements the DRO placement page reviewed in chunk 108 and the school-wide 2006-2018 tables in chunks 2-3. Columbia job-market page is the 2023-24 season across five divisions (three DRO candidates); the two per-person pages below it were not in this batch. The opportunities.alumdev.columbia.edu address is spam on a hijacked Columbia subdomain and should be excluded from any future crawl. The CBS RiBL page is a research-project page listing four CBS PhD theses (2022-2023) from several departments (design, platforms/labour, education technology, entrepreneurship), not a program list; small and without placements. The i3-CRG theses-soutenues page is paginated (page 1 of 9 captured, five 2022-2023 defenses); the 2020 page of the same site was reviewed in chunk 102, so an integrator merging CRG should fetch the remaining pages; the CRG theses-en-cours page is a roster of 16 current doctoral students (not-a-list). DRIFT Rick Bosman is a single dissertation record in transition studies at Erasmus (EGSH, social sciences), marked not-a-list as outside management; integrator may reconsider if transition/governance studies counts. All Georgia Tech pages in this batch are aerospace, mechanical, materials or computational science and engineering (or policy/news pages), none from Scheller or ISyE.
